mapper.sql: AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM task t JOIN project_member pm ON pm.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND pm.project_id = t.req_id AND pm.user_id = n.user_id AND pm.access = 'none' WHERE t.id = n.ref_task_id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workspace_member wm WHERE wm.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND wm.user_id = n.user_id AND wm.role IN ('owner', 'admin', 'viewer') ) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_notification (user_id, workspace_id, type, title, body, ref_task_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{workspaceId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{body}, #{refTaskId})
mapper.update: UPDATE app_notification SET read_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND ref_task_id = #{refTaskId} AND type = #{type} AND created_at >= #{since}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM app_notification WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND ref_task_id IN #{taskId}
